fato_historico: -74: A group of officials, led by the Western Han minister Huo Guang, present articles of impeachment against the new emperor, Liu He, to the imperial regent, Empress Dowager Shangguan.
energia_do_dia: The cosmos invites you to reflect on your personal power and the integrity of your inner council. Much like historical leaders who carefully evaluated the path of those in charge, you may find it a good time to reconsider your own direction. Trust your judgment, stay grounded, and consider how your current choices align with your long-term ambitions.
frase_do_dia: True power lies in the quiet wisdom of a steady and honest heart.
significado_numero: Represents the balance between structure and the pursuit of new possibilities.
conselho: Listen to your intuition before making any final decisions regarding your career path.
